summary: Iteration 54 — verified App Store/Play compliance surfaces: public legal pages (/privacy, /terms, /account-deletion, /support), marketing footer legal links, public deletion-request endpoint+form, and the full in-app 30-day grace-period account deletion flow (schedule with password, wrong-password 401, scheduled banner, grace-period login, cancel deletion). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed. Frontend: all flows passed via Playwright with a fresh throwaway @qatest.com user; demo accounts untouched and verified not scheduled.

ui_bugs.issue: Cosmetic: missing space before the date — renders 'scheduled for permanent deletion onOctober 4, 2026' (the {" "} before <strong> is being collapsed)

action_items: Optional cosmetic fix: add explicit space (e.g. 'deletion on ' inside the text or  ) before the date <strong> in the Profile deletion-scheduled banner.
critical_code_review_comments: purge_deleted_accounts_tick queries {"deletion_scheduled_at": {"$lt": now_iso, "$ne": None}} — string ISO comparison works only while all timestamps share the same UTC ISO format/offset; consider storing datetimes or normalising to Z-suffixed ISO to avoid future lexicographic mismatches.
Public POST /api/account/deletion-request has no rate limiting — an attacker can flood deletion_requests / trigger unlimited ack emails to arbitrary addresses. Add IP throttling.

Purge sweeps only collections keyed by 'user_id'; verify no personal data is stored under other keys (e.g. chat/AI logs, gift_cards owner fields, cart) or it will survive the purge and break the GDPR promise on the deletion page.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Account-deletion feature (backend + frontend) fully validated in iteration 54; regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration54_account_deletion.py covers status/delete/cancel/grace-login/public-request. rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Only cosmetic whitespace collapse in the scheduled banner text.
